Query_Elastic.query: FROM .ds-kibana_sample_data_logs-* | WHERE @timestamp >= '2025-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' AND @timestamp < '2025-11-01T00:00:00.000Z' | EVAL es_timestamp = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp) | STATS status_code_200_counter = COUNT(*) WHERE response == '200', status_code_5xx_counter = COUNT(*) WHERE response >= '500' AND response < '600' BY es_timestamp | SORT es_timestamp
